title: T5: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
description: T5 reframes every NLP task — classification, translation, summarization, QA — as text-to-text: input and output are always strings. This single formulation enabled training one model on many tasks simultaneously. T5 introduced the C4 dataset, explored scaling laws for encoders, and showed that a unified objective outperforms task-specific pretraining.
authors: Raffel, Shazeer, Roberts, Lee, Narang, Matena, Zhou, Li, Liu (Google Brain)
